fields.name: Target
fields.evidence: esv::crowds::CharacterMovementSystem::Update (EoCServer.dll+0xD8C530) copies value+0 (8 bytes) and value+8 (4 bytes) into esv::crowds::MoveToComponent+0 / +8 (a position; the component then gets the proxy transform). Windows: CharacterMovementSystem update bg3.exe+0x3565F80 merges the value's 8+8+4 bytes and then stores value+0 (8) and +8 (4) into the new/existing esv::crowds::MoveToComponent +0/+8 (its Target, confirmed layout).

fields.name: Radius
fields.evidence: Copied as a 4-byte value to esv::crowds::MoveToComponent+0x18 (EoCServer.dll+0xD8C530); meaning not established (speed-like). Windows: bg3.exe+0x3565F80 stores value+0xC into MoveToComponent+0x18, which the confirmed MoveTo layout names Radius (arrival when squared distance <= radius^2).

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: Copied as one byte to esv::crowds::MoveToComponent+0x21 (EoCServer.dll+0xD8C530); the merge loop copies the whole dword, so bytes 0x11..0x13 are treated as padding. Windows: bg3.exe+0x3565F80 stores the byte value+0x10 into MoveToComponent+0x21 (field_21 there, live 1..4).

fields.name: _Pad11
fields.evidence: Padding to the 4-byte alignment of the 20-byte element (allocator call FUN_180d8be90(n, 0x14, 4)).

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: Container: bg3.exe creator (AddSingleton) allocates 0x40 bytes and zeroes them; its destructor bg3.exe+0x5C4870 frees the values array at +0x30 without per-element destructors (plain data) and then the key hash set (bg3.exe+0x582AD0) = HashMap with POD values. esv::crowds::CharacterMovementSystem::Update (EoCServer.dll+0xD8C530, WorldView names DetourMoveTo/MoveTo/PatrolMoveTo RequestsSingleton const) iterates keys at +0x20 (count +0x2C, stride 8, hashed as uint64 and looked up as the entity whose MoveToComponent is created/updated) and values at +0x30 with stride 0x14 (scratch allocation FUN_180d8be90(n, 0x14, 4)). Key = crowd character entity. Writer: esv::crowds::DetourSystem::Update (macOS index: writes DetourMoveToRequestsSingletonComponent). Live (seen.py, idle): one instance, all bytes zero (empty container). Windows: CharacterMovementSystem update bg3.exe+0x3565F80 gets this singleton through bg3.exe+0x3567270 (query DAT_1463B768C, registered by bg3.exe+0x3559020 with DetourMoveToRequestsSingletonComponent) and walks keys +0x20 (stride 8, count +0x2C) and values +0x30 with stride 0x14.
